task.title: Log in to create a new user account
task.shortdesc: You create a new user account with your organization when you first log in at Red Hat Customer Portal.

ul.li: Ensure company single-sign on integration is enabled.
Ensure your organization’s account is enabled for auto-user registration.
Ensure you have a valid email with your organization.
Confirm you received information from your Organization Administrator with a link to click to complete auto-user registration.

step.cmd: Click the registration link provided by your Organization Administrator.
You are redirected to your organization's internal log in page. Log in with your organization credentials.
You are redirected to the Red Hat new user registration form. Fill out all required fields and click Create account.

info.note: In some instances, a new page may open that requires you to read and acknowledge the Red Hat account agreements in order to continue.

step.cmd: Check your email for a Red Hat account verification link. Click the verification link in the email to complete your account set up.

taskbody.result: Your Red Hat user account is now successfully set up and registered with your organization’s corporate Red Hat account.
